stem: Voltmarkt's promo share of sales divides promotion revenue by the category's total net revenue. The TV promo share rose from 20% in Q2 to 28% in Q3, and TV promotion revenue in euros was the same in both quarters. Which statement must be true?

options.text: Total TV net revenue was lower in Q3 than in Q2
Voltmarkt ran more TV promotions in Q3 than in Q2
The Q3 TV promotions gave deeper discounts
More TV lines were sold at markdown prices in Q3
